_about: Shared fixture for the source-anchor guard (extraction-api claim_anchor_guard.py and news-worker lib/claim-anchors.ts run the same cases). Each case: a claim, its sources (content + ISO published_at), and the tokens the guard must flag — an empty list means the claim passes. Cases 1-7 are the curators' batch-14 corrections (2026-09-23) in miniature.

cases.name: weekday resolved by the model to the wrong day and year is flagged
cases.claim: US President Donald Trump announced on March 4, 2025 that the US Navy could provide escorts for tankers navigating the Strait of Hormuz if necessary

sources.content: On Tuesday, President Donald Trump announced that the U.S. Navy could provide escorts for tankers navigating the strait if necessary. Only one inbound and one outbound vessel crossed on March 4.

cases.name: the curator's date for that weekday passes: code resolves Tuesday against Thursday 5 March
cases.claim: US President Donald Trump announced on March 3, 2026 that the US Navy could provide escorts for tankers navigating the Strait of Hormuz if necessary

sources.content: On Tuesday, President Donald Trump announced that the U.S. Navy could provide escorts for tankers navigating the strait if necessary.

cases.name: the article's own date used as the event date is flagged when the source says Monday
cases.claim: Eileen Wang resigned from the Arcadia City Council on May 12, 2026

sources.content: The mayor of a Los Angeles suburb resigned Monday, as federal prosecutors announced that Eileen Wang has been charged.

cases.name: Monday before a Tuesday publication is 11 May
cases.claim: Eileen Wang resigned from the Arcadia City Council on May 11, 2026

sources.content: The mayor of a Los Angeles suburb resigned Monday, as federal prosecutors announced that Eileen Wang has been charged.

cases.name: a relative weekday left in the claim is not the guard's business
cases.claim: The British government announced on Tuesday that the United Kingdom would send extra troops and air defense systems to the Middle East

sources.content: The British government announced on Tuesday that it would send extra troops and air defense systems to the Middle East.

cases.name: the weekday with its resolved date passes (Tuesday before Wednesday 1 April)
cases.claim: The British government announced on Tuesday, 31 March 2026 that the United Kingdom would send extra troops and air defense systems to the Middle East

sources.content: The British government announced on Tuesday that it would send extra troops and air defense systems to the Middle East.

cases.name: a day-and-month the source states may take the publication year
cases.claim: The Trump administration deposed President Nicolas Maduro on January 3, 2026 with US forces conducting a raid on Caracas

sources.content: Thursday's move comes after the Trump administration in January deposed President Nicolas Maduro on January 3, with US forces conducting a raid on Venezuela's capital Caracas.

cases.name: a year the model filled from its prior is flagged
cases.claim: The 90 billion euro EU loan for Ukraine was agreed in December 2024

sources.content: EU ambassadors approved the 90 billion euro loan for Ukraine, agreed last December, on Wednesday.

cases.name: a month-year with the publication year passes when the source names the month
cases.claim: The 90 billion euro EU loan for Ukraine was agreed in December 2025

sources.content: EU ambassadors approved the 90 billion euro loan for Ukraine, agreed in December 2025, on Wednesday.

cases.name: earlier this year means the publication year, not the year before
cases.claim: Meta cut around 2,000 workers in two smaller rounds of layoffs earlier in 2025

sources.content: Meta cut around 2,000 workers in two smaller rounds of layoffs earlier this year.

cases.name: last year resolves to the year before publication
cases.claim: The number of publicly traded companies in the US fell to about 4,000 in 2025

sources.content: The number of publicly traded companies in the U.S. fell from about 7,000 in 2000 to about 4,000 last year.

cases.name: a Saturday date that is not a Saturday is flagged; the real Saturday passes
cases.claim: A coalition of DeFi protocols filed a Constitutional AIP on the Arbitrum forum on Saturday, April 26, 2026

sources.content: A coalition of major DeFi protocols filed a Constitutional AIP on the Arbitrum forum on Saturday.

cases.name: the real Saturday before a Monday publication
cases.claim: A coalition of DeFi protocols filed a Constitutional AIP on the Arbitrum forum on Saturday, April 25, 2026

sources.content: A coalition of major DeFi protocols filed a Constitutional AIP on the Arbitrum forum on Saturday.

cases.name: a figure no source states is flagged; scale words and separators are normalised
cases.claim: Trading volume for US spot Bitcoin ETFs fell to approximately $14.5 billion for the week ending September 4, 2026, down from nearly $19 billion the prior week

sources.content: Trading volume for U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs fell to about $14.6bn in the week to September 4, from nearly $19,000 million the week before.

cases.name: a figure the source states in another form passes
cases.claim: Trading volume for US spot Bitcoin ETFs fell to approximately $14.6 billion for the week ending September 4, 2026

sources.content: Trading volume for U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs fell to about $14.6bn in the week to September 4.

cases.name: yesterday against the publication date, with a day of timezone tolerance
cases.claim: Iran attacked an oil tanker off the Dubai coast on 30 March 2026

sources.content: Iran attacked an oil tanker off the Dubai coast yesterday, setting the vessel alight.

cases.name: background facts from the model's memory are flagged
cases.claim: A July 2018 fireworks factory explosion in Tultepec, Mexico, killed 24 people, following another explosion that killed 42 people in 2016

sources.content: A fireworks factory explosion in Tultepec, Mexico, killed 24 people in July 2018, the town's worst since a market blast years earlier.

cases.name: clock times, ordinals and percentages in the sources are read the same way
cases.claim: Roberto Sanchez trailed with 12.1 percent in an early exit poll by Ipsos Peru on 12 April 2026

sources.content: At 10:30 pm on Sunday, Ipsos Peru's exit poll put Roberto Sanchez at 12.1% in the 12th round of counting.

cases.name: an ISO date in the source anchors a claim's long date
cases.claim: Nine countries announced the Defence, Security and Resilience Bank on 7 July 2026

sources.content: Nine countries announced the bank on 2026-07-07 at the summit.

cases.name: a year mentioned elsewhere in the article does not license a month-year
cases.claim: Eileen Wang became mayor of Arcadia in February 2025

sources.content: Wang, who became mayor in February, has resigned. A 2025 House committee report counted 60 cases of espionage.

cases.name: the publication year completes a month the source names
cases.claim: Eileen Wang became mayor of Arcadia in February 2026

sources.content: Wang, who became mayor in February, has resigned. A 2025 House committee report counted 60 cases of espionage.

cases.name: no sources at all: nothing can be checked, nothing is flagged
cases.claim: Eileen Wang resigned from the Arcadia City Council on May 12, 2026
